gauge.name: Tide Gauge at Crystal River (in MHHW)

impacts.statement: 80 percent of Crystal River is flooded.  Up to 7 feet of water in some homes along U.S. 19 near Kings Bay.
Flooding of homes extends to areas east of U.S. 19.
Most homes west of U.S. 19 are flooded with 1 to 2 feet of water inside.
One foot of water in many homes west of U.S. 19.
Water begins to flood some homes and U.S. 19 near Kings Bay.  Highway 44 west of Fort Island Trail is covered with a few inches of water.
Water floods boat ramps, docks, and low lying areas.

hydronotes.statement: Water levels are referenced to the Mean Higher High Water (MHHW) Datum. This datum can be used to approximate sea water inundation of normally dry ground near the coast. For specific impacts, please refer to the statements on this page.

gauge.forecastReliability: Graphical forecasts are not available during times of high water, forecast crest information can be found in the local WFO web page.
